name: Reaver Titan
oracle_text:
Void Shields — Protection from mana value 3 or less
Gatling Blaster — Whenever this Vehicle attacks, it deals 5 damage to each opponent.
Crew 4 (Tap any number of creatures you control with total power 4 or more: This Vehicle becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.)
blocked_sentences: Void Shields — Protection from mana value 3 or less

needs.what: a quality on the `protection` static that matches sources by mana value against a comparison (here mana value <= 3): it can't be the target of spells or abilities from such sources, can't be blocked by creatures with such mana value, damage from them is prevented, and it can't be enchanted/equipped by them (702.16). Tokens and lands (mana value 0) count as mana value 3 or less.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `protection` static takes only from_types, from_subtypes, from_colors, from_colorless and from_colors_outside_commander_identity (schema.py StaticAbility, loader protection checks); there is no quality keyed on a numeric characteristic like mana value, and approximating with any of those would protect from the wrong things
